source: Plants (Basel) / National Library of Medicine PubMed Central
title: Micropropagation of Ginger (Zingiber officinale Roscoe) 'Bentong' and Evaluation of Its Secondary Metabolites and Antioxidant Activities Compared with the Conventionally Propagated Plant
content: A peer-reviewed article on ginger lists leaf spot or blast as Phyllosticta zingiberi and Pyricularia zingiberi. This record identifies those pathogen names explicitly rather than treating ginger leaf spot as a single universal diagnosis.
author: Nisar Ahmad Zahid, Hawa Z. E. Jaafar, and Mansor Hakiman
